_note: Provenance index for the show-wide Archer-style cast portraits. Filenames are self-describing (DATE-VENDOR-MODEL-SUBJECT-PURPOSE); this file carries the recipe. No seed is recorded because the consumer Gemini image UI does not expose one. Portraits were produced by iterative edits in a single Gemini thread starting from each canonical prompt below.

format.background: flat solid warm paper #EDE9E0, no scene
format.downstream: circle/card crops applied per-asset at use time, not baked into the source

style_prompt: Flat 2D vector illustration, clean ligne claire style. Bold uniform black outlines. Flat color fills with minimal hard-edged cel shading (single darker shadow tone), no gradients, no soft rendering, no photorealism. Angular geometric simplification: defined jaw, blocky chin, simplified straight nose, minimal facial detail, pale eyes with small white catchlight. Retro 1960s mid-century spy aesthetic, confident and deadpan. Muted slightly desaturated palette. 3/4 head-and-shoulders portrait, plain flat warm-paper background #EDE9E0. Ink-black #111111 outlines; accent red #B02A28 and warm grey #78746C used sparingly.
style_naming_note: The 'Archer' show is never named in prompts (refused as copyrighted IP); the aesthetic is described instead, and a show screenshot may be uploaded as a visual style reference only.

demographics_note: Per issue #167: each portraits[] entry carries a demographics block so the roster can be measured against US Census proportions and future characters cast to correct the standing skew. race_ethnicity uses Census-mappable keys. This is a maintainer design choice recorded in the repo and in the tooling; it is NEVER surfaced on the site, in show notes, on air, or on social media. Existing portraits are classified only -- no image is reworked.
